title: 鸣潮 Hash 修复合集（3.5）
description: 内置鸣潮 3.5 Hash 修复；如果修复无效，请使用独立修复器。

source.note: The Moonholder 3.4.1/config 3.4.4 snapshot is retained as the comparison baseline. The fork 3.5.1 snapshot remains authoritative for existing direct hashes. Woju Assets 3.5.0.3 contributes only graph-isolated factual hash mappings after invalid values, self-only values, multi-target sources, conflict/cycle-reachable chains, fork-ambiguous sources and all existing source/target boundary intersections are excluded. It never retargets an existing rule. Thirteen fork context-dependent multi-target hashes remain excluded instead of choosing an unsafe global target. Strict Aemeath accessory profiles and twenty raw current/source pivots retain their existing context gates. Numeric rules, derive rules, ensure-lines operations, vertex-group remaps, buffer transforms, stride fixes and special resources are excluded.
